[SWS_DM_00968] Reporting of DTCAndStatusRecord parameter
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04180, RS_Diag_04157, RS_Diag_04067
⌈
The
DTCAndStatusRecord
parameter according to ISO 14229-1[1] as part of the re-
sponse shall consist of pairs of DTC number and its according DTC status of all sup-
ported DTCs of the DMs primary memory with no fixed and specified order.
⌋
7.3.2.8.7.8 SF 0x14 – reportDTCFaultDetectionCounter
